question: A user wants to know if they must upgrade from a free account just to try out the basic project feature with instructions and a small knowledge base. What is true about project availability on free accounts?
options: A) Projects are available to free accounts too, though free users are capped at a maximum of five projects
B) Free accounts can create projects but are never permitted to set project instructions at all
C) Projects are an exclusive Team and Enterprise feature and are unavailable on any individual account
D) Free accounts can create projects but the knowledge base feature is entirely disabled for them
correct_answers: A) Projects are available to free accounts too, though free users are capped at a maximum of five projects
explanations: Correct. Projects are available to all users including free accounts, though free users can create a maximum of five projects.
Incorrect. Setting project instructions is part of the core project feature available to free accounts, not blocked entirely.
Incorrect. Projects are not restricted to Team and Enterprise; free and Pro individual accounts can use them too.
Incorrect. The knowledge base is part of the core project experience available on free accounts, subject to the five-project cap rather than being disabled.
